baseline_merge.reason: Previously rejected and archived legacy experiment; merging it would restore retired design.

implementation.behavior: Post-report user supplement starts a new linked run with explicit per-round budget; old report stays immutable.
implementation.input: Note plus up to three sourced text records; all submissions remain unverified.

normal_path_pairs.scope: Canonical run ID, zero logical elapsed/fixed event clock; omit random spans, retrieval times and durations; renumber engine event seq after admission. Retain all model input strings, tool parameters, evidence, reviews, reports and budgets.
normal_path_pairs.latency_scope: Local deterministic model and synthetic provider, both groups persist events and terminal delivery. Admission and schema setup excluded. Does not measure real Flash latency.

failed_attempts_preserved.architecture_guard: Strict helper AST guard rejected intentional user-source provenance branch; guard now excludes only that exact branch and retains original-helper comparison.
failed_attempts_preserved.fault_point_miss: First local rework ordinal-1 unknown-call case returned partial without reaching requested kill point. Root cause of this single miss is not established. Isolated same-source replay, entire fault test on final source, and final PostgreSQL CI all pass; the initial failure is not discarded.

failed_attempts_preserved.correction: Inherited pasted records are now rechecked against current dependency permissions; request is rejected before new-run creation if scope has narrowed.

frontend_acceptance.judgment_source: AI browser observation plus deterministic HTTP/PostgreSQL assertions

preservation.runtime_note: Existing isolated demo database and server were restarted after host downtime; original tracked source, delivered reports and model ledgers were preserved.

limits: No new real Flash invocation: this acceptance proves control flow, input provenance, atomic creation, recovery and report delivery, not root-cause accuracy or real-model evidence integration.
Judgment source is AI browser observation plus deterministic assertions, not human semantic gold.
Only pasted text records are supported; files, images and graph-level human waiting are not implemented.
Each run keeps the existing single-rework limit; a user-requested followup is a separately budgeted new run.
Missing token usage remains explicitly unknown and monetary cost is not estimated.
Old report must still be the latest run for the current incident revision; ticket edits require a fresh base diagnosis.
The first local fault-point miss did not recur in isolated replay and final CI; its cause remains unknown.
